questions.subject: STATISTICS
questions.stem: A clinician's note reports a 95% CI for mean recovery time of (4, 8) days. What does this mean?

options.text: We are 95% confident the true mean recovery time is between 4 and 8 days
95% of patients recover in 4 to 8 days
There is a 95% chance the true mean is in this interval
95% of samples yield this exact interval

questions.explanation: A 95% CI means we are 95% confident the true mean lies in the interval. It is not about individual patients or probability of the parameter.
